source: RI-JRN01 O17 (input-modality parity: the whole journey is completable on gamepad only) and RI-CHR01 §1 inputs 1 and 6.
why: A free-text name box cannot be filled on a gamepad without an on-screen keyboard, and an on-screen keyboard is a full-screen non-diegetic panel, which RI-JRN01 O8 forbids outright. The resolution is the one the fiction already suggests: the Warden-Scribe has a ledger of names in use in this province, and she will read from it if you cannot or will not say your own. Typing still works on a keyboard and overrides the list; the list is what makes the scene completable with a stick and two buttons.

hatch_names.note: Argonian hatch-names in the Jel pattern. Any race may be asked for one in the hold; a non-Argonian is asked because Jeeh-Ei asks everybody, and the refusal is the interesting answer.

given_names.note: What the Office will write on the writ if you do not give it something else. One list per race, because a Warden-Scribe reading out of a Tidewrack ledger reads names that are actually in it.

custom_class_names.note: Input 7's custom-class route asks the player to name a profession. Gamepad parity needs a list here too; the scribe writes whichever of these she is given, or whatever is typed over it.
